newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb internal aluminium sales up 7.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb internal aluminium sales up 7.7 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 16,700 tonnes in February, up 7.7 percent on the 15,500 tonnes sold in February 1996, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
The result compares with sales of 17,000 tonnes in January this year and exceeded expectations given February is a shorter working month than January.
Positive performances by the automobile industry and the extrusion sector contributed to the higher sales and ABAL forecasts that March will also see a similar rise.
Sales in the first two months of the year were 12.3 percent up on January/February 1996, reaching 33,700 tonnes against 30,000 tonnes last year.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
